name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - name: Setup node24
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4

          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'
      - name: Setup deno
        uses: denoland/setup-deno@v2
